name: Corporate jargon overuse, no public-service motivation, badmouths private

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Why do you want to join the civil services?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I have a startup mindset and I want to apply my OKR-driven approach to government. I think we need more agile sprint-based execution and better stakeholder management with KPI tracking.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I worked in B2B SaaS for 5 years on customer acquisition funnels. Honestly, corporate was awful — toxic culture, just for the money. I'm tired of corporate now and want to do something else.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I'm good at running standups, writing OKRs, and KPI tracking. I bring a startup hustle that government departments need.
